messages:
sam: Brain dump: propose a "compact-projection" we keep a 4-byte summary per prefix (epoch_lo16, token8, conf8) used for eviction/admit heuristics. full lease remains canonical for handoffs/writes.
nina: Short Q: how do we avoid punishing newly recreated prefixes?
sam: Plan: epoch bit bumped on full-delete/rename. projections are only monotonic within an epoch; on epoch mismatch we force a full-lease consult.
oleg: Concern: eviction oscillation if token collisions happen. any mitigation?
sam: Add soft-grace on eviction: if a projection-driven eviction is later invalidated by full-lease, we increase that tenant's grace window for N minutes and mark projection low-confidence. Also track collision_rate.
nina: Metrics to track: projection_hit_rate, token_mismatch_rate, eviction_reorders, grace_triggers_by_tenant. Gate for canary: mismatch_rate < 0.1% and eviction_reorders < 0.05%.
sam: Rollout: feature-flagged canary nodes, start read-only metrics, then 10% traffic, emergency kill-switch to force full-lease consult. ops: add dashboard and alert if projection_mismatches spike.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag compact-projection canary=10% cluster="cachepool-c" (requested by sam).
oleg: Next step: RFC with interface, correctness sketch, migration plan and canary gates. booking 30m review Fri. Thanks!
